notes.summary: Complete independent reading of the one assigned handwritten page. All main lines, annotations, insertions and cancellations were checked against both drafts using the prescribed three image views and sixteen own open-place crops. No other reader, scan, OCR or outside source was used.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No theorem was proved or independently validated. The mismatch between the membership expected from the phrase and the visible upright-plus-bar in i [relation] I triggered close inspection; literal ink gives a turnstile. The overloaded tuple sign triggered a separation of symbol shape from cancellation state; it remains one uncertain retraced group. The superscripts were read from loops, uprights and detached points without selecting a meaning from the mathematics.

workflow_feedback: The brief permits ordinary insertion macros to represent ordinary strokes but requires distinct connectors in TikZ. This page has both: the simple H_i insertion guide is treated as ordinary insertion, while the two note pointers are drawn explicitly. A clearer rule for this boundary would improve consistency.

The one-crop limit preserves independent judgement, but retraced mathematical signs can leave cancellation history undecidable; the report therefore records one group with local state alternatives rather than multiplying unread symbols.
